title: Gyaru mo Yasai mo Kuwazugirai
titleNative: ギャルも野菜も食わず嫌い
synonyms: No Taste for Gyaru and Vegetables
synopsis: Genichi Tomita, a newspaper reporter, has just been transferred to a rural town. While house-hunting, he arranges to rent a vacant house through a referral from a former colleague back in Tokyo. But when he arrives at the address he was given, he finds nothing but a dilapidated, rundown house. As Genichi stands there at a loss, a gyaru dressed in farm work clothes suddenly appears before him — Shuri Nakazato. A comfortable slow-life rom-com begins, as our hero gets swept along by a gyaru who's absolutely obsessed with farming!!

title: Sherlock + Academy
titleNative: シャーロック＋アカデミー
synopsis: The need for detectives has dramatically increased in response to the increasing number of violent crimes. This year, a boy and a girl enter Marimine Detective Academy, an ultra-exclusive school, and the only one in Japan that offers the "National Detective License." The boy is Misaki Fujisaki, the grandson of the man who was once known as the "Crime King." The girl is Shia E. Hazeldine, the adopted daughter of the man known as the "Detective King." These two descendants of sworn enemies will meet each other by chance! And as their school days begin, an incident occurs right from the entrance ceremony!? Moreover, for some reason, Fujisaki's score is higher than Shia's, even though she supposedly solved the mystery first... "I challenge you!" "Don't regret this, princess." This is a unique academy story where students compete to find the truth. This is intellectual excitement at its highest peak! (Source: MFBunko J, translated)

synopsis: Homura-sensei is the frail biology teacher in his track-suit and white lab coat. Hasumi-san is a new home economics teacher, returning to her alma mater to be with him. Their social positions may have changed, but their feelings remain the same. The sweet, awkward romance between them continues, in this new series depicting their love story as adults! (Source: Pixiv Comics, translated) Note: Sekaneko started publishing this manga on her blog on September 14, 2021. On September 2022, the manga got licensed by Kadokawa.
